rule: BUSY if the mean utilization of a check exceeds utilization_mean_max_percent (before start and before every draw), or, before start only, if any reading exceeds prestart_memory_used_max_mib; before a draw memory is recorded, not gated (owner change of 29 Oct 2026); UNVERIFIED if any reading fails; before a draw, recheck every recheck_interval_seconds until busy_window_seconds, then BUSY_TIMEOUT
